actions.name: Adaptive rate limiting
actions.implementation: Applies deterministic ingress and egress tc flower police filters to the device IPv4 on the hotspot interface.

actions.name: Flood-specific hardening
actions.implementation: Adds the device IPv4 to a dedicated nftables timeout set during a flood response.

actions.name: Temporary source block
actions.implementation: Adds the device IPv4 to an nftables timeout set; defaults to 300 seconds.

actions.name: Port/protocol block
actions.implementation: Adds a device IPv4 and destination port tuple to protocol-specific nftables sets.

actions.name: Probe/scan filtering
actions.implementation: Temporarily denies forwarding from the scanning device IPv4 using an nftables timeout set.

actions.name: Egress and C2 blocking
actions.implementation: Blocks a device IPv4 and destination IPv4 tuple with nftables; domain-only and encrypted-SNI indicators require prior resolution.

actions.name: Aggregate source block
actions.implementation: Adds a normalized source CIDR to an interval nftables set.

actions.name: Traffic shaping
actions.implementation: Applies deterministic ingress and egress tc flower police filters to the device IPv4.

actions.name: Quarantine VLAN
actions.implementation: Requires VLAN-aware AP, bridge, DHCP subnet, and upstream switch support.

actions.name: MAC-level block
actions.implementation: Adds the device MAC to nftables ingress and egress block rules.

actions.name: Full isolation
actions.implementation: Adds the leased device IPv4 to an nftables bidirectional isolation set.

actions.name: ARP truth restoration
actions.implementation: Replaces the device neighbor entry with the trusted DHCP IP-to-MAC binding on the hotspot interface.

actions.name: ARP/DHCP inspection
actions.implementation: Pins the authoritative DHCP IP-to-MAC binding as a permanent kernel neighbor entry.

actions.name: Force encrypted channel
actions.implementation: Cannot force application-layer encryption without endpoint or proxy control.

actions.name: Re-key and re-provision
actions.implementation: Requires device provisioning credentials and may require rotating the AP key for all clients.

actions.name: Progressive source ban
actions.implementation: Uses nftables timeout bans of 60, 300, 900, 3600, or 86400 seconds for escalation levels 1-5.

actions.name: Target account lockout
actions.implementation: Requires integration with the target device or identity provider.

actions.name: Credential rotation
actions.implementation: Requires device-specific credential management or provisioning APIs.

actions.name: Network stack restart
actions.implementation: Possible only for the Pi or remotely managed devices; disruptive and requires explicit approval.

actions.name: Operator notification
actions.implementation: Writes a high-priority structured notification to the collector journal.

actions.name: Permanent quarantine
actions.implementation: Applies persistent bidirectional IPv4 isolation only after explicit operator approval.

actions.name: Incident report
actions.implementation: Stores a JSON snapshot of device identity, risk, detection counts, and traffic totals in the healing request result.
